scope: Re-ran the five most consequential checks on legal-terms-review: (1) Montana law (MCA 2-6-109 repeal, MCA 2-6-1017 text, parcel metadata, B3 brief citation); (2) MSL structures and transport metadata (access and use clauses, origin counts, dates); (3) TIGER/Line use constraints; (4) ODbL and footprint licences, including the USA Structures and NRCS AWDB licence fields; (5) the public-domain and weather sources behind the lowest-friction list. Readings are not legal advice.
method: Read the worker record in full (3,407 lines: 20 sources, 146 urls_checked entries, 19 counsel questions, 90 quote labels) and the worker summary.

Live requests with curl through the configured proxy, default curl user agent, redirects followed. 49 requests in total: 37 HTTP 200, 9 HTTP 206 range reads, 3 HTTP 403 (fema.gov disclaimer; USGS copyrights twice). No block was worked around; no headers were spoofed.

Zip members read by range request: central directory parsed from the last 64 KB (entry counts checked against the worker), member bytes fetched, CRC-32 verified, extracted SHA-256 compared with the worker's member hashes.
Quote check: HTML tags stripped, entities unescaped, curly quotes and dashes normalised, whitespace collapsed; each worker quote searched for in the live or re-downloaded text.

Cache check: three Data.gov pages were CloudFront cache hits on first read (x-cache Hit, age about 2,750 s). Re-requested under new URLs (CloudFront misses) at 03:34Z; those fresh copies were compared with the cached ones.
Downloads folder /home/user/wt/research-b35/scratch-refute-legal-terms-review/downloads/ (peak 3.7 MB; every file under 60 MB) removed after the checks.

recommendation_note: Stands, with amendments. Confirmed on the live text: TIGER/Line for streets (the state and Beaverhead roads ISO files carry the same use constraint); NWS, IEM, NODD and NCEI for weather history, with the citations and disclaimers each text asks for; the MSL address-dot hold (the 'for no other purpose' clause is quoted, and MCA 2-6-1017 subsections (4)-(10) contain no address-point exception); the per-tile footprint hold (ODbL 4.4(b) and 4.6 quoted from the live text; whether one tile is a Substantial part is for counsel); the NRCS AWDB hold (access restricted on the record, which also carries a government-works licence field); the NFHL hold (fema.gov disclaimer still 403); and the About citation (cite 2-6-1017 only, which matches the brief's D13). Amendments: (1) USA Structures: keep the hold, but change its reason. The ArcGIS item states CC BY 4.0 with an ORNL and FEMA GRO credit line, Data.gov states government-works, and AmeriGEO states no licence. Resolve that conflict first; if CC BY 4.0 is confirmed, the layer is low-friction with attribution. (2) USGS: keep it on the list but mark it as not re-verified in this run (CDN block). (3) Drop the 'no em-dashes' attribution. (4) Correct the counts and sizes in C02, C08, C32 and C35. Readings are not legal advice.
